headline: From idea to a working solution with AI
summary: I combine practical use of AI with building digital products. On my own I develop websites, web applications, Windows programs and tools that automate work. I learn best by doing — moving quickly from an idea and a new technology to a prototype I can test in real use.
lookingFor: I am looking for an environment where I can apply technical thinking, independence and AI to solve concrete problems and keep growing towards AI and automation.
aiApproach: I do not treat AI as a replacement for knowledge but as a tool that speeds work up. I pick the model and working method for the concrete problem, compare approaches, analyze results and verify them in practice. This is how I learn new technologies faster and move from problem to solution more effectively.

bullets: Diagnostics, service and technical problem solving in a B2B environment.
Independent analysis of fault causes and selection of appropriate solutions.
Task-driven work requiring accuracy, responsibility and fast learning of new technical solutions.
Independent work organization and solving non-standard problems.
experience.taught: Tracing problems down to the cause and owning the result in an environment where the fix is needed now.

bullets: Promotion/transfer from warehouse work to the logistics department.
Coordinating vehicle arrivals and departures while working in several systems in parallel.
Communication with international drivers via chat, radio and phone.
Working in an environment demanding concentration, independence and fast decisions.
experience.taught: Working across several systems in parallel and coordinating processes where mistakes are expensive.

strengths: Fast transition from idea to prototype
Independent search and testing of solutions
Combining different technologies into one solution
Consistency in bringing projects to real use
direction: I want to develop towards AI Engineering and automation — especially applications that use AI models, agents, APIs and automated workflows. I care about gaining experience on real products and gradually increasing technical responsibility.
consent: I consent to the processing of my personal data for recruitment purposes.
